subject: Kickoff: LogicInference as a platform reasoning benchmark
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the LogicInference operationalization. Our open-source release generates a dataset for evaluating logical inference — propositional logic plus a small subset of first-order logic, rendered both in semi-formal notation and in natural language. Its two long-term goals map exactly onto what model teams keep asking the platform for: (1) measure whether inference chains are real or hallucinated, and (2) test whether abstract inference skill transfers to real tasks.

Plan: make generation reproducible on the platform (it's a config-and-run of generate_dataset.py today, with a hand-edited TARGET_FOLDER — we can do better), version the outputs in Corpus, and stand up baseline fine-tunes so teams get a reference number.

Milestones: Mar 6 reproducible generation pipeline; Apr 17 v1 dataset versioned + Evalline task registered; June baseline fine-tuning grid; Jun 19 readout.

Deshawn owns staffing/compute. Yara is research lead.

Dmitri
